integrity: The forward covariance comes from published linear response; the new theorem is the exact two-statistic inverse and sharp admissibility range. Numerical checks supplement the analytical proof. Priority is subject to independent assessment.
scientific_limitations: Identifies unordered rates only, with equal known wall diffusivities and known mechanical parameters in a stationary thermodynamic-limit harmonic chain. At equal rates the inversion is not Lipschitz. No finite-size, finite-sample, other-reservoir or microscopic-noise-mechanism identification claim.
title: Two local velocity covariances determine both boundary resetting rates
